To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the brain’s representation of internal bodily state is critical for health and that the conscious experience of this state is the foundation of our sense of self.

interoception is an umbrella construct that includes (1) body‐to‐brain afferent signaling; (2) encoding and representation of this information in the brain; (3) influence of interoceptive signals on cognition, emotion, and behavior; and (4) conscious expression of interoception as physical sensations and feelings.

interoceptive processing is impaired in a wide range of physical and psychological conditions, including depression, anxiety, eating disorders, and fatigue, and that these impairments may underlie some of the symptoms of these disorders, such as the inability to feel one's body, the inability to regulate one's own emotions and feelings, and a lack of awareness about one's own body and its state.
In summary, our research is concerned with
understanding how interoception is impaired in physical and mental illness and how this can inform the development of new treatments.
understanding the neural basis of the body’s influence on the brain and mind, with the goal of improving physical and mental health.
the neural basis of bodily self‐awareness and its relation to physical and mental health and well‐being.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
interoception is an important mechanism that can contribute to the understanding of the pathogenesis and pathophysiology of many physical and mental disorders.
interoception is an important factor for physical and mental health and that it is an important factor in many diseases.
interoceptive impair­ments at different levels are related to a variety of physical and mental health disorders.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
interoceptive impairements at different levels relate specifically to physical and mental health disorders.
the neurobiology of interoceprtion is a promising new avenue to understand and treat mental health disorders.
interoceptive processing is an important and underappreciated aspect of health.
The main takeaway from our work is that
interoceptive impair­ment is a common feature in many disorders and that interoceptive training can be used to ameliorate symptoms.
a deeper understanding of the neurobiology of interocpetion can help us understand the mechanisms that underlie the development and maintenance of a wide range of health and mental health disorders.
interoception is a core process that underpins physical and mental well-being.
